DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約についてですね。言語の支援をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about booking a consultation. Would you like language support?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社の人が通訳をすると言っていますが、その人の前では話しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の人による通訳では話しにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Someone from my company says they'll interpret, but it's hard to speak in front of that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you find it hard to speak with someone from the company interpreting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような点が話しにくいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What makes it difficult to speak?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談したいのは、その会社の勤務のことです。私の希望を全部言えるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談対象がその会社で希望を言えるか不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to discuss working at that company. I'm worried I won't be able to express all my wishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the consultation concerns that company and you worry about expressing your wishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同席の希望と、ほかの言語支援の方法を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your wishes about attendance and other language support options with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の人が来る前提で予約せず、別の通訳が使えるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の同席を前提にせず別の支援を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to book assuming the company person will attend. I'd like to ask whether another interpreter is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request other support without assuming the company's attendance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の言語と、参加できる日時を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask your preferred language and the dates and times you can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。来週の火曜か金曜なら参加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望言語と参加できる候補日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Vietnamese. I can attend next Tuesday or Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your preferred language and possible attendance dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その候補と、会社の方の同席を希望していないことを担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge those options and that you do not want someone from the company present.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。別の支援が可能か確認してから、相談の方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支援の確認結果を受けて相談方法を決めると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll decide how to consult after checking whether other support is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide the consultation method based on the support check result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。手配を確約せず、方法を確認してご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I can't promise arrangements, but I'll check the options and contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更希望の日時は、このメモでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the date and time you want to change to as written in this note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。水曜の零時と書きました。昼休みに来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼休みに受診したいという意図を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote Wednesday at zero o'clock. I want to come during my lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you intend to attend during your lunch break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昼休みでしたら、夜中の零時とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it's your lunch break, that's different from midnight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十二時は零時とも言うと聞いて、そう書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二時を零時と記入した理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard twelve o'clock can also be called zero o'clock, so I wrote that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you wrote twelve o'clock as zero o'clock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 午前零時と正午の十二時は分けて伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish midnight from twelve noon when telling us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 希望は昼の十二時ごろです。その時間に予約があるか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正午付近の予約枠があるか確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want around twelve in the daytime. Can you check if there's an appointment at that time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether there is an appointment slot around noon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補があるか調べます。希望時刻を書いたことだけでは予約は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the options. Writing your preferred time alone does not confirm an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。メモを正午に直します。水曜という曜日は変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 曜日を保ち時刻の表現だけ訂正すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll correct the note to noon. The day, Wednesday, stays the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the day and correct only the expression of the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。昼の時間をご希望という内容で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll check on the basis that you want a daytime appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。候補を聞いて、仕事の昼休みで間に合うか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された候補と昼休みを比べてから決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll hear the options and consider whether I can make it during my work lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the options with your lunch break before deciding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 実際にご案内できる時間が分かってから、ご判断ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please decide after we know the actual times we can offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくなった自転車の写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a photo of the missing bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この赤い自転車です。ただ、今使っていたものは青でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手元の写真と紛失車体の色が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this red bicycle. But the one I was using now was blue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the photo and missing bicycle have different colours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 赤いものと青いものの関係を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain how the red and blue bicycles are related.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い私の自転車は修理店にあります。青いものは、その間借りた代車です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私物は修理中で紛失品は代車だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My red bicycle is at the repair shop. The blue one was a temporary replacement I borrowed meanwhile.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your own bicycle is being repaired and the missing one is a loaner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: なくなったのは、借りていた青い自転車なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the missing one is the borrowed blue bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分の写真を出してしまいました。代車の番号は店に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真の誤提示を訂正し店へ車体番号を確認できると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I mistakenly showed a photo of my own. I can check the loaner's frame number with the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the wrong photo and say the shop can confirm the frame number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 借りた際の控えもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a receipt from borrowing it too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。ここに店名と貸出日があり、車体番号はまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出控えと未確認の番号を区別して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It has the shop name and loan date; I don't yet know the frame number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the loan receipt from the unconfirmed number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 代車の特徴と、最後に置いた場所を伺います。店にも状況を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the loaner's features and the last place you left it. Please tell the shop what happened too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い代車を駅前に置きました。修理中の赤い車体までなくなったとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代車の場所を伝え私物まで紛失と扱わないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I left the blue loaner in front of the station. I won't say my red bicycle being repaired has gone missing as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the loaner's location and make clear your own bicycle is not also missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。代車に関する情報を確認しながらお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hear your account while checking information about the loaner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出人欄はこちらにご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please fill in the sender section here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母からの贈り物なので、母の名前と私の住所を書こうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族名と自分の住所を合わせて書く予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a gift from my mother, so I was going to write her name and my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to combine a family member's name with your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物について連絡や返送が必要な場合は、どなたが対応しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Who will handle any contact or return concerning the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私です。母は海外にいて、この住所には住んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母は海外で発送後の対応は自分がすると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will. My mother is overseas and doesn't live at this address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your mother is overseas and you will handle matters after dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 贈る方の紹介と、発送後に対応する連絡先は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish introducing the giver from the contact handling matters after dispatch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母が贈ったと相手に伝えるには、別のカードを入れてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 贈り主を紹介する別カードを入れられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I put in a separate card telling the recipient that my mother gave it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may include a separate card introducing the giver. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中のメッセージはご自身で整えてください。差出人の情報は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please prepare the message inside yourself. The person in charge will check the sender information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄に、住んでいない母の名だけを書くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住んでいない人の名だけを差出人にしたくないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to avoid writing only my mother's name here when she doesn't live there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you don't want to list only a non-resident's name as sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返送先として使う住所と、対応する方の情報を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the return address and the details of the person handling matters, then advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私はこの住所で受け取れます。母からの贈り物ということはカードに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返送に対応できる本人情報と贈り主メッセージを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can receive it at this address. I'll write on the card that it's a gift from my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate your return-contact details from the giver's message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対応する方の情報と、贈り物のメッセージを分けて進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's proceed with the responsible person's information separate from the gift message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座をどのような目的で使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: For what purpose do you plan to use the account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別の銀行から、自分の貯金を移すためです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の貯金を移す予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: To transfer my savings from another bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to transfer your savings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初の入金のお話ですね。その後は何にお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's about the first deposit. What will you use it for afterwards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事の給与を受け取り、生活費を管理したいです。質問を同じ意味だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今後の給与受取と生活費管理を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: To receive my work salary and manage living expenses. I thought the questions meant the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain future salary receipt and living expense management. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初のお金がどこから来るかと、口座の利用目的は別々に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We ask separately where the initial money comes from and the account's purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、給与が最初から入ると書かず、初回は自分の貯金と説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初回入金は給与ではなく貯金と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't write that salary comes in from the start; I'll explain the first deposit is my own savings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the initial deposit to savings rather than salary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の貯金の口座は、ご本人名義ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your current savings account in your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の名義です。初回の移動と、今後の給与受取を分けて書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元口座が本人名義だと伝え二つの情報を分けたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, mine. I want to write the initial transfer and future salary receipt separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the source account is yours and you want to separate the two facts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容を担当が確認します。必要な資料もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will confirm that and explain the documents needed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料を聞いてから用意します。二つの欄へ同じ文をそのまま写さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要資料を聞き出所と目的を別々に記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask what documents are needed before preparing them. I'll avoid copying the same sentence into both sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about documents and state you will enter source and purpose separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お金の出所と今後の使い道を、それぞれ確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the source of the money and future uses separately before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートのどの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the receipt concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この品を一個しか買っていないのに、二行あります。二個分払いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一個なのに二行あるレシートを問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought only one of this item, but there are two lines. Did I pay for two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a receipt with two lines for one item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二行目の金額の前に、マイナスの表示がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a minus sign before the amount on the second line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三百五十円の下に、マイナス五十円です。追加の値段だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 価格行とマイナス行を読み上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Below 350 yen it says minus 50 yen. I thought it was an additional price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read out the price line and the negative line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは値引きの行です。二つの金額を足す行ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the discount line. The two amounts are not to be added together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では三百五十円から五十円を引き、三百円ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 値引きを引いた実額を計算する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So 350 yen minus 50 yen is 300 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Calculate the actual amount after subtracting the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この品の購入数は一個と表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The purchased quantity of this item is shown as one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋にも一個あります。レシートの点数と、金額の行を分けて見るんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元の個数とレシートの購入数を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is one in my bag too. So I should distinguish the quantity from the amount lines on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the item in hand to the purchased quantity on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。お会計全体の合計もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Exactly. Please check the total for the whole purchase too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合計を確認できました。二重購入として返品を求めず、このレシートを保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二重購入ではないと理解して記録を保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the total. I won't request a return for a duplicate purchase; I'll keep this receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Understand it wasn't a duplicate purchase and keep the record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の意味を確認できましたので、お持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Now that we've clarified the label's meaning, please take it with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで少しお待ちください。今は走る方が通過しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait here a moment. Runners are passing through now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向こうの花壇へ行きたいです。人の間が空けば渡っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 走者の間を横断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the flowerbed over there. May I cross when there's a gap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can cross between runners. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この行事中は、横断できる時に係員がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: During this event, staff will tell you when you may cross.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分で間を見て走って渡るのはやめます。待つ場所はここで大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己判断の横断を控え待つ位置を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't judge a gap myself and run across. Is it okay to wait here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Refrain from crossing at your discretion and ask where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この印の後ろでお願いします。走る方の通路へ出ないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Behind this mark, please. Do not step into the runners' lane.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向こうで友人が待っています。今すぐ着くとは連絡しない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ確定した到着を約束しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend is waiting over there. I shouldn't say I'll arrive right away, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you should not promise your friend a definite arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 横断できる時刻はまだ決まっていません。待っていることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't yet know when you can cross. Tell your friend you're waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この印の後ろで待つと連絡しました。合図があったら、荷物をまとめて渡ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待つ位置を連絡し合図で渡る準備をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've told them I'm waiting behind this mark. When signalled, I'll gather my bags and cross.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the waiting position and prepare to cross on the signal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今からご案内します。足元を確認して、こちらの横断区間をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll guide you now. Watch your footing and use this crossing section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。案内された区間で歩いて渡り、花壇の友人へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内された区間を歩いて横断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll walk across in the indicated section and go to my friend at the flowerbed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk across the indicated section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。渡り終わるまでは、途中で撮影のために止まらずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Keep moving until you've finished crossing, without stopping midway to take photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の購入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble buying a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ駅が二つ出ています。安いほうを買えば、どちらの経路でも行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ目的地の二つの価格と利用範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The same station appears twice. If I buy the cheaper one, can I take either route?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about two prices for the same destination and their permitted use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経路によって利用できる切符が違う場合があります。どちらの経路をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which tickets can be used may differ by route. Which route do you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗り換えが少ないほうです。金額だけを見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗り換えが少ない経路を優先したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one with fewer transfers. I was looking only at the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your priority is fewer transfers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、まずその経路を画面で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check that route on the screen first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらは別の会社の線も通りますね。この表示を選べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別会社を通る経路の画面を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one uses another company's line too. Should I choose this display?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the screen for a route using another company's line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先に加えて、経由の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the via information as well as the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この切符では、途中で別の経路に変えても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中で経路を変えられるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: With this ticket, would it be okay to change to another route partway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may change routes partway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更する前に係員へお尋ねください。同じ行き先だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask staff before changing. Having the same destination alone doesn't determine it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日はこの経由に合う切符を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ経由に合う切符を購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll buy a ticket matching this route today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy a ticket matching the selected route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。購入後も、迷ったら乗車前に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Even after purchase, check before boarding if you're unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 用紙の記入についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about filling out the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。申請者の下に代理人の欄があります。ここにも自分の名前を書くんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 代理人欄に本人の名前も書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There's a representative section below applicant. Should I put my name here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to put your own name in the representative section too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は、誰の手続きを誰が行いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Who is doing whose procedure this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私自身の手続きを、私がします。代理人はいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人が自分の申請を行うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm doing my own procedure. There is no representative.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you are applying for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況なら、二つの役割を同じ意味だと思わずに記入案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, let's check the instructions rather than assuming the two roles mean the same thing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が日本語を説明してくれましたが、その友人が代理人になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明を手伝った友人が代理人に当たるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: A friend explained the Japanese to me. Does that make that friend my representative?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether a friend who explained things counts as a representative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明を手伝ったことだけで、代理の手続きをしているとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Helping with an explanation alone does not necessarily mean carrying out a procedure as representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は友人は来ていません。私が申請内容を確認して出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が内容を確認して提出することを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend isn't here today. I'll check the application details and submit it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will personally check and submit the details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの本人申請の案内に沿って進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please follow these instructions for applying in person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 代理人の欄の扱いを確認してから、必要な欄だけ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入対象を確認してから書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check how to handle the representative section, then fill in only the necessary sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check which sections to fill in before writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。迷う欄は、そのままにして窓口で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Leave any sections you're unsure about as they are and check at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診療に関係する資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any documents related to your treatment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。海外の検査結果です。家族から英語の資料だと聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外の検査資料を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, test results from overseas. My family told me they were in English.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought overseas test documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらを見せていただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どうぞ。見直すと、英語の見出しだけで、説明の部分はベトナム語です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 英語は見出しだけで本文は別言語だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here you are. Looking again, only the headings are English; the explanations are Vietnamese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that only headings are English and the body is another language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その区別を診療担当へ伝えます。日本語の訳はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the medical staff that distinction. Do you have a Japanese translation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。私が全部読めるわけでもないので、ここで訳を決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訳がなく本人も全体を理解していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I can't read all of it myself either, so I don't want to settle on a translation here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain there is no translation and you do not fully understand the document yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の資料の言語と、訳がないことを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them the original document's language and that there is no translation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数値だけを別の紙に写すより、この資料全体を見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数値の抜書きではなく原資料を示したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to show the whole document rather than copy only the numbers onto another sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to show the original document rather than an extract of numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。必要な確認や資料の扱いは担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Consult the person in charge about necessary checks and how to handle the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 検査した日と病院名も分かるページをそろえます。内容を理解したとは言わず提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付と病院名のページも添え理解を断言せず提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll include pages showing the test date and hospital name. I'll submit it without claiming I understood the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Include the date and hospital pages and submit without claiming understanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。資料と、現在分かっていることを一緒に担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11242-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll pass the documents and what is currently known to the person in charge together.
